doc.title: Germaine Bazzle interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006

title: Growing up in a musical family
summary: Her parents and relatives played piano; she learned 'Sweet Sue' at nine or ten and got formal lessons two years later.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Was music part of your life from a young age?

Yes. Um hum. I grew up in a home where there was music all of the time. My dad played piano, my mom played, and my aunts and uncles played, and there was a song called “Sweet Sue” that my dad used to play all of the time. And I learned to play that song. I guess I must have been about nine or ten years old. And two years later my mom decided that I should have some formal training and it went from that. But there was always music.
